product.title: Small-Group Half-Day Whale-Watching Tour in Puerto Vallarta

description.text: In Puerto Vallarta, this small-group half-day looks for humpback whales on Banderas Bay with a marine biologist guide. The boat includes a restroom, and lunch plus soft drinks are served on board so the morning stays on the water rather than a separate restaurant stop. Hotel pickup is listed for many properties, with a small cash port fee collected at departure. The group format is aimed at visitors who want expert commentary without booking a private charter. Seasonal whale presence still depends on winter migration, and the published route keeps a respectful distance from the animals. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Puerto Vallarta, and the itinerary stays on Marina Vallarta and Banderas Bay that define this wildlife outing.

highlights: Half-day small-group whale-watching tour from Puerto Vallarta
Cruise the waters of Banderas Bay to spot migrating humpback whales
Learn about whale behavior from the marine biologist guide
Lunch and soft drinks keep hunger pangs at bay
